sourceEvidence.detail: Action phase exporter marks every non-null Frames and FramePausedOnHitlag callback unknown.
Shared execution path installs ActiveChar.FramePausedOnHitlag when the action has no override.
Default FramePausedOnHitlag returns frozenFrames > 0; frozenFrames is already represented in character phase state.
NewAttackFunc, NewAttackFuncWithOffset, NewAbilFunc, NewAbilFuncWithOffset capture frame tables, normal counter, one actual attack-speed read and optional offset.
